free_tier.stated: No free tier. Buy page 2026-10-23: 1 Month $11.95 per month; 1 Year $3.99 per month billed at $47.88; 3 Years + 3 Months $2.03 per month, autorenews at $79 every 3 years.

egress.terms: unverified for a byte figure: the buy page states Unlimited Device Security but no page read states a traffic allowance. PIA is widely described as unmetered, which did not confirm from a vendor sentence.; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: Token and port are HTTP calls to the connected gateway on port 19999 (/getSignature, /bindPort); the scripts wrap them.
tooling: pia-foss manual-connections scripts with wg-quick and curl/jq, or the official app.
chaining: A token endpoint plus a bind loop is a five-line cron job on a free VM; the VM then holds a stable public UDP endpoint for the life of the signature.

limits.value: a bound port is deleted if the bind is not renewed: Call /bindPort every 15 minutes, or the port will be deleted. The port signature is valid for two months: All ports currently expire after 2 months.
port forwarding is disabled server side in the United States: Port Forwarding is disabled on server-side in the United States.

binding_note: No byte cap is stated, so the binding constraint is the 15-minute bind renewal: the port exists only while a loop keeps re-signing it. That is the same class of failure as Proton's lease but with a 900-second period instead of 60.

identity_cost.detail: An account with credentials used by the scripts as PIA_USER and PIA_PASS; payment by card or PayPal.

reliability_note: Losing the 15-minute renewal loop silently drops the port mapping while the tunnel stays up. United States servers cannot forward at all.
confidence_note: Measured would need a token, a bound port, a live UDP request through it and a byte count. The 15-minute and 2-month sentences are in the vendor's own repository README, read today.

evidence.proved: Native WireGuard plus port forwarding from vendor scripts; port signature valid 2 months; /bindPort must be called every 15 minutes or the port is deleted; port forwarding is off in the United States.
Prices: $11.95 monthly, $3.99 per month on 1 year at $47.88, $2.03 per month on 3 years at $79.

Indexed copy of the vendor article: a random port is automatically assigned, only specific locations support port forwarding, and a manual option exists for non-app clients. The live path returned 404 from the restructured helpdesk.

notes: Two candidates for why the helpdesk article 404s: (1) the helpdesk was migrated to a new platform and the path changed, supported by the redirect to a different article slug on the same host; The GitHub route was used instead. The port number itself is stable for the life of the signature, which is the property Proton lacks.

extras.wg_detail: Run with PIA_PF=true to bind the port on the same connection.

extras.transit_note: Traffic crosses the PIA server a user is bound to; the port is only valid on the gateway of that server.
